request.docs: Rows and seat ids; never changes, so it is cacheable for a day (CDN). Saves A1 and A2 as `seatIds`.
Which seat ids are taken right now. Cached for 1 second.
Seats are held in Redis for 5 minutes; Postgres still says AVAILABLE. Saves `holdId`.
Held by Asha: all-or-nothing Lua script in Redis refuses the whole hold.
What a checkout page reads after a refresh to show the timer.
Seats become BOOKED (guarded UPDATE), then the hold is deleted. Owner comes from the token. Saves `bookingId`.
The hold is gone once booked.
The server picks the best adjacent block that is neither booked nor held.

request.docs: Frees the seat now instead of after 5 minutes.
Shows that haven't started, soonest first (the default period).
Shows that have started, latest first.
Seats A1, A2 go back on sale in the same transaction. After the show starts this answers 409 `Show has already started` (needs a past show, so not part of this collection).
Idempotent: a retry gets the same answer, and the seats are not released twice.
Re-sale works: Asha's cancelled seat rows no longer block the seats.
